hook_line: RUPEE HITS SEVEN-MONTH HIGH NEAR ₹93.40, SQUEEZING IT EXPORTERS' EARNINGS

hook_stat.sub: Rupee per US dollar on November 18, its strongest level in seven months

stats.label: Rupee gain so far in November, on course for its best month in 20 months
Net foreign institutional investment in Indian stocks through November 17
Fall in the Nifty IT index so far this month

diaspora_bullets: Each dollar sent to India now converts into fewer rupees than at the year's weakest point of ₹96.81 per dollar
TCS and Infosys earn most revenue in dollars but pay a large share of costs in rupees
news_summary: The Indian rupee climbed to around ₹93.39–₹93.41 per US dollar on November 18, its strongest level in seven months, squeezing the rupee earnings of TCS, Infosys and other IT exporters.
payoff: The rupee remains about 4% weaker than on January 1, when a dollar cost ₹89.98.
